title: fix: Gzip comment with header checksum produces corrupt streams
issueTitle: Bug report: Gzip operation produces invalid streams when using comments with header checksum
why: The report gives the exact setup (Gzip with Comment "test" and Include file checksum, input "hello hello hello") and says decompressing with Gunzip fails with an invalid header crc16 error, so on the fixed build a Gzip-then-Gunzip round trip should output the original text.
